## Orientation

Parallel tasks in this wave edit disjoint files. Stay inside your task scope. Install node_modules in your worktree with `npm ci` in `dashboard/web/ui` when you need npm. Do not push.

Write root: `/home/andrewyin/orchestra/.worktrees/node-ci--fix-type-errors`

### Work-item (quote)

## Description

R10: `npm run check` exits 0 in `dashboard/web/ui`. It fails today with 3 errors: `src/taskGraph.ts:218` (`nodeW` is not a known property), `src/App.svelte:123` (`efforts` does not exist on type `never`), `src/App.svelte:189` (`open` does not exist on type `never`).

## Approach

Fix each error at its cause with a real type, not a cast to `any` or a suppression comment. Run `npm run check` and `npm test` after each fix. Change no behavior.

### Requirements (quote by id)

R10: `npm run check` exits 0 on the tree.

### Design / decisions (quote)

- The lint gate allows zero findings.
- The `web` job has no path filter and no dependency on other jobs.

- A Node version exists that Vite 8 and the pinned Biome both support.
- The Biome rule set can be tuned (for example `noNonNullAssertion`) in `biome.json` without per-line suppressions.

- `lint-findings-policy`: Fix the findings and keep zero findings
